= Broken PlantUML Block

The block below is not valid PlantUML: it opens a sequence but never declares a
diagram, and the `@startuml` marker is missing entirely. PlantUML answers with an
error image and a non-zero exit, which is what this fixture exists to produce.

[plantuml]
----
this is not plantuml at all
!!! neither is this
@enduml
----
